result.note: Tests the structurally significant May 2026 assembly results: the BJP's first win in West Bengal and TVK topping the Tamil Nadu assembly.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the assembly election results announced in May 2026:
items: The Bharatiya Janata Party won West Bengal for the first time, securing 206 of the state's 294 seats.
The Tamilaga Vetri Kazhagam won an outright majority on its own in the Tamil Nadu assembly.
In Tamil Nadu, the Congress joined a coalition with the Tamilaga Vetri Kazhagam after leaving the DMK-led alliance.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because TVK topped the assembly but fell short of a majority, forcing a hasty coalition with the Congress, which was poached from the DMK-led alliance. In West Bengal, at least four people were killed in post-poll violence after the BJP's win.
questions.source: At least four people were killed after the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) secured West Bengal for the first time, winning 206 of 294 seats.

questions.prompt: Which party became the first non-Dravidian party since the 1960s to emerge as the largest party in the Tamil Nadu assembly in the elections of May 2026?
questions.explain: Vijay's two-year-old Tamilaga Vetri Kazhagam topped the assembly, becoming the first non-Dravidian party to do so since the 1960s. Vijay met the Governor on 6 May 2026 to stake his claim to form the government.
questions.source: TVK became the first non-Dravidian party to top the assembly since the 1960s.
